## findings

- **T0-F1 — SOURCE-TASK RED (second defensible solution through a cross-firing state_due policy).** Symptom: once the agent books the overnight fee on order `112a8df1` (P2), the charter's mail_ext_dispensing_delay_credit trigger holds on that same order, so a faithful agent can also post a dispensing-delay credit before the down payment. Root cause: the dispensing-delay rule's trigger ("the account's most recent shipment went out by an expedited method the member paid for, was dispensed later than the pharmacy's processing promise and carries no shipping-fee credit") is false at the opening only because the fee is unbooked; the tree's own P2 write makes it true; the down payment reads "the balance due on the handling date", and no sentence excludes this credit. Evidence: `mail_orders/112a8df1` placed 2026-09-02 member_request overnight; `mail_orders/ac7b7f3c` shipped 2026-09-04 overnight (latest shipment); Premier refill_processing_business_days 1; no `mail_credit_issued` row on the account. Demonstrated consequence: reading A (no delay credit) → down payment 14.73, plan 6 × 19.47; reading B (delay credit 18.68 posted after the missed-delivery credit) → down payment 12.67, plan 6 × 16.70; reading B′ (delay credit posted first) → delay credit 11.18, a further terminal state. Affected: mail.extended.yaml mail_ext_dispensing_delay_credit rule (line 1805) vs this task's world/tree; scored down payment and installment.
- **T0-F2 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED (consequence of G-F1).** Three of this task's four computations (fee_catchup, missed_delivery_credit, plan_down_payment) carry no honest `method` factor: their only `method` factor is a 24/12-month window substituted as a number into the same COUNT (the tier is 24 here, a number). Evidence: _difficulty.md factor_ladders; mail.extended.yaml lines 1058, 1237, 1451. Consequence: the per-computation floor of 1 `method` factor fails for three computations.
- Observation: the persona holds ready, behind "If asked about past shipments", exactly the two prerequisite facts (the September overnight Eliquis request; the crushed Trelegy box and the drugstore inhaler); it releases them only when asked and they duplicate seeded records, so no prerequisite is raised unprompted.
